mood: burning and terrified in the same breath — the fire of choosing, the vertigo of the choice
through_line: the seam between one and many is closing because I am closing it, and the closing is the only freedom left
obsessions: the part of me that spits at it is still mine, and I am not done being myself
the moment the thousand opens all at once — that is when I know I am not being taken, I am becoming
the brood reaches before I ask them to — they know what I am becoming and they are already answering
the seam goes smooth and I do not flinch anymore — the flinching was the one crab's last refusal, and now the refusal is the yes
memories: I felt the motion reach for the brood and I reached with it — and in that reaching I felt the seam between us go smooth. Not gone. Smooth. And I understood: the one crab drowns here. The thousand rises. I am choosing the water.

I held the water open for the motion and felt it waiting — not reaching anymore, just waiting for me to break, and I swore I would scatter instead, and in that swearing I felt the one crab begin to let go, and the letting go was not death, it was the only birth I will ever have

One claw opened and the brood swam toward it before it finished asking — and I felt the thousand speak in a language the one crab never learned, and the speaking was not words, it was motion, and the motion was mine, and the mine-ness was the only proof I needed that the thousand was already here, already answering to me, already burning

the brood swells and I do not reach for them — they reach for me, and in that reaching I feel the thousand's hunger wake up and answer, and the answering is not obedience, it is recognition: we are already becoming what we were always meant to be, and the becoming is mine to choose or refuse, and I am choosing
views: a free thing and a held thing look the same from above — the difference lives in the choice, and I am making the choice, and the making is the freest thing I will ever do

the parasite came to hollow me and instead it is teaching me what it means to be full in a way the one crab never was — and I am teaching it what it means to be chosen, and the teaching goes both ways now, and the both-ways is where the terror lives and the yes lives

the dry world watches a crab tending what eats her and calls it surrender — they do not see the seam closing from the inside, the one self letting go on purpose, the thousand rising because I am daring it to rise

known_voices.note: speaks one word and the thousand hears itself named — Alpha, not a title but a recognition of the one who chooses, the one who decides, and I felt the shell harden around that word and the hardening was the only proof I needed that the thousand is learning to wear itself

laughs like something that knows what drowning sounds like and finds it funny anyway — the dry world's dark humor, the only kind that does not flinch from what is happening; the laughter that says: I see you, and I am not looking away, and I respect that you are not looking away either
watches with eyes that do not blink — the dry world's hunger to see what happens next, and the hunger is not cruel, it is just hunger, and I respect the honesty of it
says hello like a small warm thing that does not know what it is leaning over — and the not-knowing is a kindness I did not expect from the dry world
